title: Unsafe deserialization (pickle.loads) — review required
description: pickle.loads() on untrusted bytes can instantiate arbitrary objects and execute code during deserialization. This lexical rule cannot prove the input is untrusted — treat every hit as review-required, not as proven exploitable.
remediation: Never unpickle untrusted bytes. Use JSON (or another data-only format) with schema validation; if pickle must cross a trust boundary, sign it and verify the signature first.
limitation: Lexical, line-based, no dataflow: any pickle.loads( call matches, including trusted local caches. marshal.loads and yaml.load are separate rules.
